## Importación de los DataFrames

```{r}
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(magrittr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(GGally)
```

```{r}
poblacion <- read_tsv('data/poblacion_paises.tsv')
#str(poblacion)
#head(poblacion)

colnames(poblacion)[1] <- 'country'
poblacion %<>% mutate(country = sub("^.*,", "", country)) %>% mutate(across(-1, ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x))))

poblacion %<>% transmute(country, population = rowMeans(select(., -country), na.rm = TRUE))
# Calculamos la media poblacional de cada pais desde el 2000 hasta hoy

poblacion %<>% arrange(desc(population)) %>% filter(!(country %in% c('RU', 'UA', 'DE_TOT', 'TR', 'FX', 'BY', 'AZ', 'UK')))
# Ordenamos los paises de mayor a menor poblacion
# Eliminamos algunos que no pertenecen politicamente a Europa

mas.poblacion10 <- poblacion$country[1:10]
# Nos quedamos con los nombres de los 10 primeros

mas.poblacion5 <- poblacion$country[1:5]
# Nos quedamos con los nombres de los 5 primeros
```

```{r}
indep.resid <- read_tsv('data/edad_independencia_residencial.tsv')
#str(indep.resid)
#head(indep.resid)

colnames(indep.resid)[1] <- 'sex.country'
indep.resid %<>% mutate(sex.country = sub("^.*,([^,]*,[^,]*)$", "\\1", sex.country)) %>% separate(sex.country, into = c('sex', 'country'), sep = ',') %>% mutate(sex = factor(sex))

indep.resid %<>% mutate(across(c(-1, -2), ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(-1, -2), names_to = 'year', values_to = 'age.indep') %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% filter(sex == 'T' & country %in% mas.poblacion10) %>% select(-sex) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = mas.poblacion10, labels = mas.poblacion10))
```

```{r}
precio.vivienda <- read_tsv('data/precio_vivienda.tsv')
#str(precio.vivienda)
#head(precio.vivienda)

colnames(precio.vivienda)[1] <- 'country'
precio.vivienda %<>% mutate(country = sub(".*,", "", country))

precio.vivienda %<>% mutate(across(-1, ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = 'year.quadri', values_to = 'rel.price2015.house')

precio.vivienda %<>% separate(year.quadri, into = c('year', 'quadri'), sep = '-') %>% mutate(quadri = factor(quadri, ordered=TRUE)) %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% filter(country %in% mas.poblacion10 & quadri == 'Q1') %>% select(-quadri) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = mas.poblacion10, labels = mas.poblacion10))
```

```{r}
precio.alquiler <- read_tsv('data/precio_alquiler.tsv')
#str(precio.alquiler)
#head(precio.alquiler)

colnames(precio.alquiler)[1] <- 'country'
precio.alquiler %<>% mutate(country = sub(".*,", "", country))

precio.alquiler %<>% mutate(across(-1, ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = 'year', values_to = 'rel.price2015.rent') %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% filter(country %in% mas.poblacion10) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = mas.poblacion10, labels = mas.poblacion10))
```

```{r}
salarios <- read_tsv('data/salarios.tsv')
#str(salarios)
#head(salarios)

colnames(salarios)[1] <- 'age.country'
salarios %<>% mutate(age.country = sub("^[^,]*,([^,]*,).*,([^,]*)$", "\\1\\2", age.country)) %>% separate(age.country, into = c('age', 'country'), sep = ',') %>% mutate(age = factor(age, ordered = TRUE))

salarios %<>% mutate(across(c(-1, -2), ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = c(-1, -2), names_to = 'year', values_to = 'income') %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% filter(country %in% mas.poblacion10) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = age, values_from = income)
colnames(salarios)[c(3,4)] <- c('income.1824', 'income.2549')
salarios %<>% mutate(income = (income.1824+income.2549)/2) %>% select(c(-income.1824, -income.2549))
```

```{r}
salarios2 <- read_tsv('data/salarios2.tsv')
#str(salarios)
#head(salarios)

salarios2 %<>% transmute(country = ref_area.label, year = time, earnings = 0.9*obs_value, source = factor(source.label))
names.country <- c('Germany', 'France', 'Italy', 'Spain', 'Poland', 'Romania', 'Netherlands', 'Belgium', 'Greece', 'Czechia')
names.country %in% salarios2$country
salarios2 %<>% filter(country %in% names.country) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = names.country, labels = mas.poblacion10))

major.source <- salarios2 %>% count(country, source) %>% group_by(country) %>% arrange(desc(n)) %>% slice(1) %>% mutate(major.source = source) %>% select(c(-source, -n))

salarios2 %<>% full_join(major.source) %>% mutate(earnings = ifelse(source == major.source, earnings, NA)) %>% select(c(-major.source, -source))
```

```{r}
ipca <- read_tsv('data/ipca.tsv')
#str(ipca)
#head(ipca)

colnames(ipca)[1] <- 'country'
ipca %<>% mutate(country = sub(".*,", "", country))

ipca %<>% mutate(across(-1, ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = 'year', values_to = 'rel.value2025.ipca') %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = mas.poblacion10, labels = mas.poblacion10))
```

```{r}
retr.pagos1629 <- read_tsv('data/retrasos_pagos_16-29.tsv')
#str(retr.pagos1629)
#head(retr.pagos1629)

colnames(retr.pagos1629)[1] <- 'country'
retr.pagos1629 %<>% mutate(country = sub("^.*,", "", country))

retr.pagos1629 %<>% mutate(across(-1, ~ as.numeric(gsub('[^0-9.]', '', .x)))) %>% pivot_longer(cols = -1, names_to = 'year', values_to = 'arrears.rate') %>% mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>% filter(country %in% mas.poblacion10) %>% mutate(country = factor(country, levels = mas.poblacion10, labels = mas.poblacion10))
```

## Transformaciones de variables

```{r}
jovenes.df <- indep.resid %>% full_join(salarios2) %>% left_join(ipca) %>% full_join(precio.alquiler) %>% full_join(precio.vivienda) %>% full_join(retr.pagos1629)


year.start <- jovenes.df %>% group_by(country) %>% arrange(year) %>% select(c(country, year, rel.price2015.rent, rel.price2015.house, earnings)) %>%  filter(if_all(everything(), ~ !is.na(.x))) %>% slice(1) %>% ungroup() %>% transmute(country, year.start = year) 

jovenes.df <- full_join(jovenes.df, year.start)

jovenes.df %<>% group_by(country) %>% mutate(real.earnings = earnings*rel.value2025.ipca[year==unique(year.start)]/rel.value2025.ipca) %>% ungroup() %>% select(c(-earnings, -rel.value2025.ipca))

jovenes.df %<>% group_by(country) %>% mutate(rel.earnings = real.earnings/real.earnings[year == unique(year.start)]*100, rel.price.rent = rel.price2015.rent/rel.price2015.rent[year == unique(year.start)]*100, rel.price.house = rel.price2015.house/rel.price2015.house[year == unique(year.start)]*100) %>% select(c(-year.start, -real.earnings, -rel.price2015.house, -rel.price2015.rent)) %>% ungroup()

jovenes.df %<>% mutate(earn.prop.house = rel.earnings/rel.price.house*100, earn.prop.rent = rel.earnings/rel.price.rent*100)
```

## Análisis bivariante

```{r}
ggplot(data = filter(jovenes.df, country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025)) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = rel.earnings, color = 'earnings'), linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = rel.price.house, color = 'house buying'), linewidth = 1, linetype = 2, na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = rel.price.rent, color = 'rent'), linewidth = 1, linetype = 3, na.rm = TRUE) + facet_wrap(.~country, nrow = 4) + labs(title = 'Evolución porcentual del salario real de los jóvenes, precio de la vivienda y precio del alquiler', subtitle = 'En función de países') + xlab('Year') + ylab('Percentage')
ggsave('results/viviendas_salarios.pdf', width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
jovenes.df %>% filter(country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025) %>% ggplot(aes(x = rel.earnings, y = rel.price.house)) + geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) + 
   geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) + facet_wrap(.~country, nrow = 4) + xlab('Income percentage (100% in 2025)') + ylab('Housing price percentage (100% in 2025)') + labs(title = 'Precio de la vivienda frente a salario real de los jóvenes', subtitle = 'En función de países')
```

```{r}
jovenes.df %>% filter(country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025) %>% group_by(country) %>% summarise(cor.pearson = cor(rel.earnings, rel.price.house, method = 'pearson', use = 'complete.obs'), cor.spearman = cor(rel.earnings, rel.price.house, method = 'spearman', use = 'complete.obs'))
```

```{r}
jovenes.df %>% filter(country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025) %>% ggplot(aes(x = rel.earnings, y = rel.price.rent)) + geom_point(na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, na.rm = TRUE) + facet_wrap(.~country, nrow = 4) + xlab('Income percentage (100% in 2025)') + ylab('Rent percentage (100% in 2025)') + labs(title = 'Precio del alquiler frente a salario real de los jóvenes', subtitle = 'En función de países')
```

```{r}
jovenes.df %>% filter(country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025) %>% group_by(country) %>% summarise(cor.pearson = cor(rel.earnings, rel.price.rent, method = 'pearson', use = 'complete.obs'), cor.spearman = cor(rel.earnings, rel.price.rent, method = 'spearman', use = 'complete.obs'))
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = filter(jovenes.df, country != 'EL', year >= 2005 & year <= 2025)) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = earn.prop.house, color = 'by house prices'), linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) + 
  geom_line(aes(x = year, y = earn.prop.rent, color = 'by rent'), linewidth = 1, na.rm = TRUE) + facet_wrap(.~country, nrow = 4) + labs(title = 'Evolución del salario en proporción al precio de la vivienda y del alquiler', subtitle = 'En función de países') + xlab('Year') + ylab('Percentage (100% in 2025)')
ggsave('results/proporcion_salario.pdf', width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

## Análisis visual

```{r}
age.mean <- jovenes.df %>% group_by(year) %>% summarise(age.mean = mean(age.indep, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
ggplot() + geom_line(data = jovenes.df, mapping = aes(x = year, y = age.indep, color = country), linewidth = 1.15, na.rm = TRUE) + geom_line(data = age.mean, mapping = aes(x = year, y = age.mean, color = 'mean'), linewidth = 1.15, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(jovenes.df$country))), unique(jovenes.df$country)), "mean" = "black")) +
  labs(title = 'Evolución temporal de la edad de emancipación') + xlab('Year') + ylab('Age')
ggsave('results/edad_emancipacion.pdf', width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```
